scene_meta.participants: Queen Eduhauana, Lord Commander Enlil, War-Matron Tiamat, War-Sage Marduk
scene_meta.focus: On the war-moon above Sol-3, Anunnaki leadership notes that 73% of the Igigi successfully scattered across quantum foam; Queen Eduhauana orders Nibiru moved into permanent eclipse positioning to trigger planetary ice-age protocols as punishment for indigenous resistance and refugee survival.
scene_meta.continuity: Follows the Igigi scatter protocol at Eridu in scene 016.1
scene_meta.cutscene purpose: Anunnaki orbital command session authorizing the Nibiru eclipse and planetary ice-age protocols.

scene_meta.participants: Zephyr, scattered Igigi refugees, indigenous surface populations
scene_meta.focus: Zephyr emerges from his shelter on Sol-3 to witness Nibiru sliding between Sol-3 and its star, casting an engineered perpetual shadow that plunges the planet into grinding cold and disrupts surface populations and refugee survival.
scene_meta.continuity: Immediately follows the Anunnaki orbital deployment in scene 017.1
scene_meta.cutscene purpose: The visual and environmental onset of Nibiru's shadow and perpetual ice age over Sol-3.

scene_meta.time: approximately year 14,014 / fourteenth year of Zephyr's isolation
scene_meta.focus: After fourteen years of solitary survival using energy-optimization algorithms, Zephyr is trapped in a catastrophic blizzard that exceeds his survival thresholds; abandoning mathematical logic, he broadcasts an emotional distress call and is rescued by an eight-foot Tidecaller Giant, initiating Zephyr's first direct bond with a Tidecaller Giant.
scene_meta.continuity: 14 years after the onset of Nibiru's shadow in scene 017.2
scene_meta.cutscene purpose: Zephyr's near-fatal encounter in the blizzard, his distress call, and the rescue by a Tidecaller Giant that forms Zephyr's first direct bond with a Giant.
